title: Preview on 100 connectome subjects
differences_from_source: Maps use 100 randomly chosen connectome subjects (outputs are labelled PreviewN100) to check the setup in minutes; group connectivity stabilises only above about 150-200 subjects, so preview results are not for reporting.
Per-lesion maps are thresholded with the N-aware Bonferroni FWE rule (re-derived for N = 100).
description: A quick check of the lesions, the connectome and the outputs before the full run.
